source_name: ZRSZ / ESS - Objava prostega delovnega mesta (employer vacancy-notification rules)
why_relevant: Explains the statutory vacancy-notification channel: employers publish vacancies free of charge via the Employer Portal, and the ESS search engine is stated to see 20,000+ jobseeker visits daily. This is the legal backbone that makes the state board the most complete employer census - including small payment/ATM vendors invisible elsewhere.

source_name: GOV.SI – Direktor Agencije za zavarovalni nadzor (agency head public competition posting)
why_relevant: Worked example proving that the top-of-house appointments at Slovenian financial supervisors (AZN director) are advertised through the central government vacancy register, not only on the agency's own site. Establishes the collection pattern for detecting supervisor leadership turnover at the earliest point — the call for candidates, months before the appointment.

source_name: SPOT - Sporočilo o prostem delovnem mestu (obrazec PDM-1)
why_relevant: Documents the PDM-1 vacancy-notification form - the administrative artefact behind every registered SI vacancy. Defines the field set (occupation code, location, contract type, deadline) that any structured collection of SI hiring data should mirror, and confirms the legal duty that makes the state register near-complete.

source_name: ZRSZ Napovednik zaposlovanja (employment forecast survey)
why_relevant: Semi-annual employer survey in which firms state expected hiring and headcount reduction by activity; gives forward-looking signal on financial-sector staffing intentions ahead of any formal redundancy notice. Published as PDF reports with a stable naming pattern.

source_name: Slovenian business media coverage of association elections (Delo, RTV SLO, Siol, N1)
why_relevant: Independent, dated confirmation and context for association board elections that the associations themselves report tersely (e.g. GZS presidency change; RTV SLO and Siol tag pages aggregate by organisation). Useful for resolving ambiguity about effective dates and mandates.

source_name: Gorenjska banka – Dodatna razkritja (corporate governance disclosure PDF)
why_relevant: Pillar-3 style governance disclosure describing internal and corporate governance arrangements, board committees and organisational setup — the most structural org-change evidence a bank publishes voluntarily.

source_name: SDH — Letno poročilo o upravljanju kapitalskih naložb RS in SDH (annual management report)
why_relevant: Annual reports document the kadrovska komisija's activity and board changes across state-held financial companies, giving a consolidated retrospective of leadership moves and governance reorganisations that scattered news items miss. Also anchors the actor map of state-owned financial entities.

source_name: Sindikat Nove Ljubljanske banke (Sindikat NLB)
why_relevant: House union at Slovenia's largest bank and a distinct bargaining actor: reporting indicates Sindikat NLB signed the 2026 tarifna priloga to the banking collective agreement while SBS refused. Tracking it separates employer-aligned from confrontational union positions and reveals NLB-internal staffing/branch decisions. No confirmed own website found — registry entry used as the anchor record.

source_name: Delavska hranilnica – Letna poročila (annual reports PDF)
why_relevant: Corporate governance chapter lists every board/supervisory-board change during the year with dates — a reliable backfill and reconciliation source for missed announcements.

source_name: European Payments Council — Slovenia instant payment environment insight
why_relevant: Documents that BIPS was implemented by Bankart in 2019 on the SCT Inst scheme — the scheme-migration context that explains and dates payments hiring waves. Useful as a benchmark layer, not as a hiring feed.

source_name: Slovenian business/general media as a leadership-move tripwire (Delo, RTV SLO, N1, 24ur, Lider, Svet24)
why_relevant: Reports supervisor leadership moves and candidate fields well before, and sometimes instead of, formal publication — e.g. coverage of the ten candidates for BS governor and of the prolonged 2025 vacancy after Governor Vasle's term expired on 8 January 2025. Also the only practical source for contested or withdrawn nominations, which never reach the gazette.

source_name: Siol.net - corporate leadership change round-ups (nova imena na čelu družb)
why_relevant: Slovenian media periodically publishes consolidated 'new names at the helm' pieces naming bank management board changes (e.g. Nova KBM board change) - cheap corroboration for LinkedIn-sourced moves.

source_name: Bloomberg - Slovenia central bank coverage
why_relevant: Global wire that covers Slovenian central-bank appointment politics in English, sometimes ahead of local confirmation (e.g. the Rop nomination story); valuable as an early-signal channel for regulator leadership.

source_name: Commercial Payments International (CPI)
why_relevant: Niche commercial-payments community that indexed Slovenian processor news (Bankart/Nets) in English; archives items after original vendor pages rotate, matching this cell's archival rationale.

entity_name: Državni zbor RS + Urad predsednice republike
source_name: Državni zbor RS + Urad predsednice republike – governor nomination and appointment channel
why_relevant: The BS Governor and Council members are appointed by the National Assembly on the proposal of the President of the Republic. The President's office publishes the nomination; the DZ publishes the vote. This is the earliest authoritative signal of central-bank leadership change — months ahead of the Uradni list decision — and the 2025-26 vacancy episode shows how long and contested the pipeline can be.

entity_name: Hrvatska narodna banka / host-regulator approval notices for Addiko board appointments
source_name: Hrvatska narodna banka / host-regulator approval notices for Addiko board appointments
why_relevant: Illustrates the regulator-approval pattern for Addiko-group board appointments; useful as a cross-border corroboration channel and as a template for finding equivalent Bank of Slovenia fit-and-proper decisions.

source_name: IUS-INFO — labour-law commentary on collective dismissals
why_relevant: Legal-publishing commentary explaining the collective-dismissal procedure (consultation with unions on redundancy criteria, ZRSZ notification, severance formula of one third or one half of average pay per year of service). Useful for interpreting whether a given bank restructuring was legally compliant and what documents must exist — which in turn tells you what to look for.

source_name: Styria digital marketplaces d.o.o. - MojeDelo/bolha operator (ownership pointer)
why_relevant: Establishes that the biggest SI board sits inside the Styria network, which also runs regional marketplaces - useful for anticipating cross-portal syndication of the same vacancy (deduplication) and for finding sister properties that carry the same ads.

source_name: Svet24 / Uporabna stran — Slovenian trade coverage of Money Motion speakers
why_relevant: Slovenian-language articles that name which Slovenian fintech/payments figures are speaking at regional conferences (e.g. Benjamin Jošar, Nina Dremelj, Antonio Argir). Useful as a pointer to individuals and their current affiliations, and as a way to catch Slovenian participation the English event site buries.

source_name: The Fintech Times
why_relevant: Runs occasional country deep-dives on Slovenia's fintech scene that name founders, executives and employers — a pointer to the actor map for A5 hiring/leadership tracking even though it is not a people-moves column.

source_name: ZDR-1 art. 99 — Program razreševanja presežnih delavcev (statute text)
why_relevant: Defines the numeric thresholds (10 workers if 20–100 employed; one tenth if 100–300; >30 if over 300) that force an employer into a formal redundancy programme with union consultation and ZRSZ notification. These thresholds tell you exactly when a bank restructuring becomes publicly detectable versus when it can stay silent — a scoping rule for the whole cell.
